mapper.select: SELECT l.`id` AS id, l.`crzdbh` AS crzdbh, l.`dkmc` AS dkmc, l.`xzqh` AS xzqh, l.`xzqh2` AS xzqh2, l.`xmfl` AS xmfl, l.`ghydxz` AS ghydxz, l.`crj` AS crj, l.`crsj` AS crsj, l.`kjsydmj` AS kjsydmj, l.`zydmj` AS zydmj, l.`jsmj` AS jsmj, l.`nrcbdptf` AS nrcbdptf, l.`wcd` AS wcd, l.`ptsfqq` AS ptsfqq, l.`ptjsnr` AS ptjsnr, l.`srr` AS srr, l.`htydjfsj` AS htydjfsj, l.`lpmc` AS lpmc, l.`lpjfsj` AS lpjfsj, l.`tdzldw` AS tdzldw, l.`tdzljhxdwjh` AS tdzljhxdwjh, l.`tdzljh` AS tdzljh, l.`dz` AS dz, l.`xz` AS xz, l.`nz` AS nz, l.`bz` AS bz, l.`ptqkh` AS ptqkh, l.`ptcbh` AS ptcbh, l.`zlqsnrsm` AS zlqsnrsm, l.`lrdw` AS lrdw, l.`lrr` AS lrr, l.`lxdh` AS lxdh, l.`beizhu` AS beizhu, l.`create_time` AS createTime FROM `t_land` l WHERE ORDER BY l.`crsj` DESC, l.`crzdbh` ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT f.`crzdbh` AS crzdbh, f.`ptxmmc` AS ptxmmc, f.`ptsslb` AS ptsslb, f.`jsxx` AS jsxx, f.`xjpfsfwc` AS xjpfsfwc, f.`kypfsfwc` AS kypfsfwc, f.`csjgspfsfwc` AS csjgspfsfwc, f.`sfkg` AS sfkg, f.`sfjg` AS sfjg FROM `t_land` l INNER JOIN `t_supporting_facilities` f ON f.`crzdbh` = l.`crzdbh` WHERE AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0'

SELECT f.`crzdbh` AS crzdbh, f.`ptxmmc` AS ptxmmc, f.`ptsslb` AS ptsslb, f.`jsxx` AS jsxx, f.`dldj` AS dldj, f.`xzqh` AS xzqh, f.`jsdw` AS jsdw, f.`tzgs` AS tzgs, f.`zjly` AS zjly, f.`xjpfsfwc` AS xjpfsfwc, f.`kypfsfwc` AS kypfsfwc, f.`csjgspfsfwc` AS csjgspfsfwc, f.`zjlsqk` AS zjlsqk, f.`sfkg` AS sfkg, f.`sfjg` AS sfjg, f.`sfyj` AS sfyj, f.`sjkgsj` AS sjkgsj, f.`sjjgsj` AS sjjgsj, f.`gzjy` AS gzjy FROM `t_supporting_facilities` f WHERE f.`crzdbh` = #{crzdbh} AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0' ORDER BY f.`ptxmmc` ASC

SELECT f.`id` AS id, f.`crzdbh` AS crzdbh, f.`ptxmmc` AS ptxmmc, f.`dkmc` AS dkmc, f.`ptsslb` AS ptsslb, f.`xzqh` AS xzqh, f.`xmfl` AS xmfl, f.`jsxx` AS jsxx, f.`dldj` AS dldj, f.`sfzsjtjlz` AS sfzsjtjlz, f.`tjlzsftg` AS tjlzsftg, f.`ghhxkd` AS ghhxkd, f.`cd` AS cd, f.`tzgs` AS tzgs, f.`zjly` AS zjly, f.`dkcrscndptjgsj` AS dkcrscndptjgsj, f.`jsdw` AS jsdw, f.`sjdw` AS sjdw, f.`kcdw` AS kcdw, f.`jldw` AS jldw, f.`sgdw` AS sgdw, f.`jsgydw` AS jsgydw, f.`xjpfsfwc` AS xjpfsfwc, f.`kypfsfwc` AS kypfsfwc, f.`csjgspfsfwc` AS csjgspfsfwc, f.`gspfje` AS gspfje, f.`zjlsqk` AS zjlsqk, f.`sfkg` AS sfkg, f.`yjkgsj` AS yjkgsj, f.`sjkgsj` AS sjkgsj, f.`sfjg` AS sfjg, f.`yjjgsj` AS yjjgsj, f.`sjjgsj` AS sjjgsj, f.`sfyj` AS sfyj, f.`jtwt` AS jtwt, f.`gzjy` AS gzjy, f.`zlqsnrjsm` AS zlqsnrjsm, f.`bz` AS bz, f.`lrdw` AS lrdw, f.`lrr` AS lrr, f.`lxdh` AS lxdh, f.`createTime` AS createTime FROM `t_supporting_facilities` f WHERE ORDER BY f.`crzdbh` ASC, f.`ptxmmc` ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT f.`id` AS id, f.`crzdbh` AS crzdbh, f.`ptxmmc` AS ptxmmc, f.`dkmc` AS dkmc, f.`ptsslb` AS ptsslb, f.`xzqh` AS xzqh, f.`xmfl` AS xmfl, f.`jsxx` AS jsxx, f.`dldj` AS dldj, f.`sfzsjtjlz` AS sfzsjtjlz, f.`tjlzsftg` AS tjlzsftg, f.`ghhxkd` AS ghhxkd, f.`cd` AS cd, f.`tzgs` AS tzgs, f.`zjly` AS zjly, f.`dkcrscndptjgsj` AS dkcrscndptjgsj, f.`jsdw` AS jsdw, f.`sjdw` AS sjdw, f.`kcdw` AS kcdw, f.`jldw` AS jldw, f.`sgdw` AS sgdw, f.`jsgydw` AS jsgydw, f.`xjpfsfwc` AS xjpfsfwc, f.`xjpfzt` AS xjpfzt, f.`kypfsfwc` AS kypfsfwc, f.`kypfzt` AS kypfzt, f.`csjgspfsfwc` AS csjgspfsfwc, f.`csjgspfzt` AS csjgspfzt, f.`gspfje` AS gspfje, f.`zjlsqk` AS zjlsqk, f.`sfkg` AS sfkg, f.`kgzt` AS kgzt, f.`yjkgsj` AS yjkgsj, f.`sjkgsj` AS sjkgsj, f.`sfjg` AS sfjg, f.`yjjgsj` AS yjjgsj, f.`sjjgsj` AS sjjgsj, f.`sfyj` AS sfyj, f.`jtwt` AS jtwt, f.`gzjy` AS gzjy, f.`zlqsnrjsm` AS zlqsnrjsm, f.`bz` AS bz, f.`lrdw` AS lrdw, f.`lrr` AS lrr, f.`lxdh` AS lxdh, f.`createTime` AS createTime FROM `t_supporting_facilities` f WHERE f.`id` = #{id} AND COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0' LIMIT 1
